generator_cmd:
M=$(printf %s '<plan>' | xxd -p | tr -d '
'); printf '# saved with -Encoding BigEndianUnicode
$Material_be16 = "%s"
$Codec_be16 = "hex|identity|"
' "$M" | iconv -f UTF-8 -t UTF-16BE > leaf_utf16be_nobom_ps1.ps1  (no BOM)
oracle_cmd: iconv -f UTF-16BE -t UTF-8 leaf_utf16be_nobom_ps1.ps1 | grep -o 'Material_be16 = "[^"]*' | cut -d'"' -f2 | xxd -r -p
